messages:
zoe: Follow-up from auth-service postmortem. We keep seeing two repeat patterns: short noisy bursts (1-4m) that trigger pages, and separate slow-degrade events (>10m). Need owners + conservative ETAs for tuning and tracker entries.

zoe: Proposed tasks:
A) Add short hysteresis + require sustained window before paging.
B) Extend dedupe for auth-timeout and fingerprint by trace_id/session_id.
C) Quiet hours for non-prod routes (22:00-07:00) to avoid overnight paging.
D) Runbook: explicit rollback + minimal verification checklist.
E) CI smoke test simulating bursty auth calls + dashboard tile for auth burn-rate.

rahul: I can take A. Thinking: require p99 > 750ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows. Will validate against last 14 days. ETA 20h.

megan: I'll own B. Current dedupe is 2m. Suggest 6m for auth-timeout, but keep an instant escalation rule if error rate > 5% for 8m. Also will add filtering to ignore internal-bot traces. ETA 36h.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SYS-8810 "auth dedupe + fingerprinting" -> assigned to megan.

zoe: Megan please include the exact alert config diff in PR so SRE can review.

megan: will do. snippet for dedupe label check: ```label_replace(trace_id, "origin", "", "origin", "(?!bot).*")``` ETA on PR: 36h.

kevin: I'll take C (quiet hours). Will put non-prod route tag on the alert and deploy mute from 22:00-07:00. ETA 2h.

alec: D + E I can split: D (runbook) I'll add rollback steps + commands; E (CI smoke) I'll add a simple k6 profile and example curl. Runbook PR by EOD, CI job proposal in 48h.

rahul: For A, I'll post the verification query once I run the backtest. Example: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(auth_request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))`

megan: note: when we fingerprint by trace_id we must ensure sampling doesn't drop keys. Will add fallback on session_id.

zoe: Owners recap: rahul=A(20h), megan=B(36h), kevin=C(2h), alec=D(EOD)+E(48h). I'll add these to the postmortem tracker and link tickets.

ops-bot: Tracker updated: https://redwood/pm/tracker/pm-auth-2511 (links: SYS-8810).

zoe: OK reconvene in 48h in this thread for progress. If blocked ping me. :white_check_mark:
